ns2:course.label: Orchestral Literature II
ns2:course.description: Study of orchestral and symphonic literature from about 1850 to the present. Prerequisite: Graduate orchestral conducting majors only; consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Graduate orchestral conducting majors only; consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
